## LmdbJobRunScheduleOptions.pattern property

Cron expression for the schedule, resolved by `croner`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
pattern: string;
```

## Remarks

5-field (minute precision), 6-field (second precision) and 7-field (OCPS, with a trailing year) patterns are supported. A pattern is a \*\*wall-clock\*\* schedule, not a duration — "03:00 every day" is a different thing from "24 h after the last successful run". See `example/job-run.ts`<!-- -->.
